Ellen B: quick note 90% of our cust-delta LoRA onboarding smoke failed cents in invoices. uploaded evalpack: cust-delta-invoice-mini.json :link:
Ravi: example?
Ellen B: prompt 0007: 'Amount owed: $3,210.45' -> model returns '3210' or '3,210' intermittently under long context.
Leo: did their finetune include a custom tokenizer?
Ellen B: yes, cust_delta_tok_v2. our merge applied LoRA without rebasing token ids.
Ravi: run tokenmap diff: `tools/tokenmap_diff.py --base models/umbra-base/tokenizer.json --other customer/tokenizers/cust_delta_tok_v2.json`
Ravi: diff highlights punctuation and digit token id shifts (e.g. `".": 56 -> 512`).
Leo: that will misalign embedding indices for LoRA. Remap LoRA token ids then rerun.
Ellen B: there's `scripts/rebase_lora_tokenids.py` in repo. plan: (1) fp16 baseline, (2) int4 w/o remap, (3) int4 with remap. I'll queue tests.
EvalBot: quick-eval started job ej-101210 on dedicated-gpu-4. ETA 8m.
Ravi: results: fp16 cents preserved 99.1%, int4 w/o remap 73.0%, int4 with remap 96.2%. logs: /mnt/results/ej-101210/summary.json
Ellen B: good, remap recovers quality. I'll open onboarding PR to auto-detect tokenizer mismatch and run remap during adapter merges. tagging Leo for review.
